def CuspBounded : Prop :=

        (∀ i, Xs i ∈ lieAt V (τs i)) → ∀ g,
          ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun t : Fin k → ℝ => φ (g * (List.ofFn fun i => oneP θ V (τs i) (Xs i) (t i)).prod)) →
      (∃ N : ℕ, ∀ l : List (D.what₂.Tau × Matrix (Fin V.rank) (Fin V.rank) ℂ), (∀ p ∈ l, p.2 ∈ lieAt V p.1) →
        ∀ x, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ g ∈ GinfC V,
          ‖(l.foldr (fun p f => Rder θ V p.1 p.2 f) φ) (x * g)‖ ≤ C * normInf θ V g ^ N) →
      IsCuspFun V φ →
      ∀ l : List (D.what₂.Tau × Matrix (Fin V.rank) (Fin V.rank) ℂ), (∀ p ∈ l, p.2 ∈ lieAt V p.1) →
        ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ g, ‖(l.foldr (fun p f => Rder θ V p.1 p.2 f) φ) g‖ ≤ C

      ∃ (L : Finset (List (D.what₂.Tau × Matrix (Fin V.rank) (Fin V.rank) ℂ))) (C : ℝ),
        (∀ l ∈ L, ∀ p ∈ l, p.2 ∈ lieAt V p.1) ∧
        ∀ φ : GA D V → ℂ, IsAutFun V φ → (∀ k ∈ U, k ∈ GfC V → ∀ g, φ (g * k) = φ g) →
          (∀ (k : ℕ) (τs : Fin k → D.what₂.Tau) (Xs : Fin k → Matrix (Fin V.rank) (Fin V.rank) ℂ),
            (∀ i, Xs i ∈ lieAt V (τs i)) → ∀ g,

          (∀ l : List (D.what₂.Tau × Matrix (Fin V.rank) (Fin V.rank) ℂ), (∀ p ∈ l, p.2 ∈ lieAt V p.1) →
            ModGrowthExp V A (l.foldr (fun p f => Rder θ V p.1 p.2 f) φ)) →
          IsCuspFun V φ →
          ∀ c : List (D.what₂.Tau × Matrix (Fin V.rank) (Fin V.rank) ℂ) → ℝ,
            (∀ l ∈ L, ∀ g, ‖(l.foldr (fun p f => Rder θ V p.1 p.2 f) φ) g‖ ≤ c l * height V g ^ A) →
            ∀ g, ‖φ g‖ * quotHeight V g ^ N ≤ C * ∑ l ∈ L, c l

GlobalTheory.Published.DiscreteSeriesCla.signature:
def DiscreteSeriesClassification : Prop :=
  ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ (H : (Fin n → Bool) → (Fin n → ℝ) → Type) (_ : ∀ ε lam, NormedAddCommGroup (H ε lam))
    (_ : ∀ ε lam, InnerProductSpace ℂ (H ε lam))
    (π : ∀ ε lam, Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ → (H ε lam →L[ℂ] H ε lam)),
    (∀ (ε : Fin n → Bool) (lam : Fin n → ℝ),
      (StrictAnti lam ∧ ∀ a, ∃ m : ℤ, lam a - ((n : ℝ) - 1) / 2 = (m : ℝ)) →

      (CompleteSpace (H ε lam) ∧ Nontrivial (H ε lam) ∧ IsURepOn (UJset ε) (π ε lam) ∧
          IsIrredOn (UJset ε) (π ε lam) ∧ IsSqIntOn ε (π ε lam)) ∧

        HasInfChar ε (fun a => (lam a : ℂ)) (π ε lam) ∧

        (∃! S : Submodule ℂ (H ε lam), IsKTypeOf ε (π ε lam) (lam + rhoN ε - rhoC ε) S) ∧

        ∀ (μ : Fin n → ℝ) (S : Submodule ℂ (H ε lam)), IsKTypeOf ε (π ε lam) μ S →
          ∃ c : Fin n → Fin n → ℕ, (∀ a b, c a b ≠ 0 → a < b) ∧
            μ = (lam + rhoN ε - rhoC ε) + ∑ a, ∑ b, (c a b : ℝ) • root a b) ∧

    ∀ (ε : Fin n → Bool) (H' : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup H'] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H']
      (σ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ → (H' →L[ℂ] H')),
      (CompleteSpace H' ∧ Nontrivial H' ∧ IsURepOn (UJset ε) σ ∧ IsIrredOn (UJset ε) σ ∧ IsSqIntOn ε σ) →
      ∃ (s : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (mu : Fin n → ℝ),
        (StrictAnti mu ∧ ∀ a, ∃ m : ℤ, mu a - ((n : ℝ) - 1) / 2 = (m : ℝ)) ∧
        (∀ a b, a < b → ε (s a) = ε (s b) → s a < s b) ∧
        ∃ T : H' ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H (ε ∘ s) mu, ∀ g ∈ UJset (ε ∘ s), ∀ v,
          T (σ (g.submatrix s.symm s.symm) v) = π (ε ∘ s) mu g (T v)

        ‖w‖ ^ 4 / ∫ g, ‖inner ℂ w (σ (umat g) w)‖ ^ 2 ∂((sc N ε : ENNReal) • Formalism.REAL.muG ε) =
          (∏ a : Fin N, ∏ b ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun b : Fin N => a < b), |lam a - lam b|) /
